findings.source_quote: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law –Hebrews 7:12.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the clause without adding a conditional 'si' that changes the original assertion. A faithful Spanish rendering preserving the original meaning: "Porque cambiado el sacerdocio, es necesario que haya también cambio de la ley — Hebreos 7:12." (Preserve the <em> tags around the verse as in the source.)
findings.translation_quote: Porque si cambia el sacerdocio, es necesario que haya también cambio de ley – Hebreos 7:12.

findings.source_quote: That we [should] henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine… –Ephesians 4:14.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the parallel sense 'tossed to and fro, and carried about' so the Spanish conveys both ideas. Suggested faithful rendering: "para que ya no seamos niños, sacudidos y llevados de acá para allá por todo viento de doctrina… — Efesios 4:14." (Keep the <em> tags around the verse as in the source.)
findings.translation_quote: para que ya no seamos niños, sacudidos por todo viento de doctrina… – Efesios 4:14.
